stage0088b_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$メラン$$
「N23-32, E161-22...
　This is Point X, where we were
　once warped to Paradigm City...!」

stage0088b_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Also, we've confirmed the recovery
　of all personnel, including
　Mr. $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0088b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Of course, the members we thought
　had vanished have safely
　returned as well.」

stage0088b_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$號$$
「The world has been saved...
　by $$ロジャー・スミス$$, who gave
　hope to her heart.」

stage0088b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$フェルト$$
「October 23rd...
　One week since the battle
　against the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$.」

stage0088b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オットー$$
「Only one week left until
　the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ announcement...!?」

stage0088b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We lost time in an unexpected place...」

stage0088b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain $$ジェフリー$$...!
　We've made contact with Captain
　Testarossa of $$メリダ島$$!」

stage0088b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$キャシー$$
「While we were away, it seems
　Neo Zeon's $$アクシズ$$ has begun
　moving toward Earth!」

stage0088b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Commander $$レディ・アン$$ of $$プリベンター$$
　sent word, too...! Supreme Command will
　meet them with Brigadier General $$サイガス$$'s fleet!」

stage0088b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Damn you, $$シャア$$...!
　He struck first, before Supreme Command
　could finish prepping the colony attack!」

stage0088b_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$...!
　Shouldn't we head to space
　right away as well...!」

stage0088b_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But after all this fighting, each
　of $c's ships has taken heavy damage...」

stage0088b_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「At the very least, we need to make
　emergency repairs. Let's head for
　the $$ミスリル$$ base on $$メリダ島$$.」

stage0088b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「One week until the $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　announcement... Does $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　mean to settle things with the Federation...?」

stage0088b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$オットー$$
「The Red Comet learned we were away
　and saw it as a golden opportunity!
　That has to be it!」

stage0088b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ブライト$$
（I can't believe the $$シャア$$ of today
　would resort to such an underhanded
　tactic...）
